summary: FD_TC_216_3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim NOT Opened � Non-EU Country � User Disputes � Manual Handoff
title: 3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim NOT Opened � Non-EU Country � User Disputes � Manual Handoff
description:
Validates that when a claims company is rejected on the "no claim opened" + non-EU path but disputes, the system escalates to manual handoff.

Prerequisites:
Third-party caller type: Claims Company. Passenger has NOT opened a claim. Country of origin: US. User disputes rejection.
